integrity: The proof reduces the published downward-confluence condition to monotonicity of row minima and the published forward-confluence condition to monotonicity of row maxima. Simultaneous confluence then forces either all rows empty or all rows nonempty. For fixed monotone endpoints, row interiors are independent, producing the exact weighted sum. Direct exhaustive relation-level checking through four worlds and an independent dynamic-program evaluation of the endpoint formula corroborate the result.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the modal-relation component of finite frames whose intuitionistic preorder is a labelled chain. It does not count valuations or formulas, prove a finite-model property, or provide an asymptotic formula. The confluence conditions themselves predate KI and also occur in LIK; the recent source is the introduction and completeness theorem for KI.
title: Endpoint normal form and exact census for finite-chain KI frames
